business_summary: Guangzhou Haige Communications Group Incorporated Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wireless communications, Beidou navigation, aerospace, and digital intelligence ecology businesses in China. The company offers shortwave communication, ultra-shortwave communication, satellite communication, digital trunking, artificial and unmanned collaborative communication, 5G, and digital communication. It also supplies emergency management communication systems and terminals; and provides simul simulation services, aircraft component manufacturing, and civil aviation navigation, and communication services, as well as vehicle simulators, electric motion platforms, visual systems, UAV simulation systems, and flight simulation training. In addition, the company engages in research and development, production, sells, engineering construction and provision of related technical services for wireless communication equipment, Beidou navigation products, simulators, civil aviation communication and navigation equipment, as well as aircraft parts processing and communication technology services. Further, the company offers technical services, development, consulting, exchanges; technology transfer and promotion; investment activities with own funds; non-residential real estate leasing; housing leasing; parking services; data processing and storage support services; big data services; digital technology services; data processing services; Internet data services; satellite remote sensing data processing; geographic remote sensing information services; intelligent control system integration; artificial intelligence public service platform technical consulting services; software development; software sales; software outsourcing services; and domestic freight forwarding services. Guangzhou Haige Communications Group Incorporated Company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: 광저우 하이게 통신 그룹 법인(Guangzhou Haige Communications Group Incorporated Company)은 자회사와 함께 중국에서 무선 통신, Beidou 내비게이션, 항공우주 및 디지털 인텔리전스 생태학 사업에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 단파 통신, 초단파 통신, 위성 통신, 디지털 트렁킹, 인공 및 무인 협업 통신, 5G 및 디지털 통신을 제공합니다. 또한 비상 관리 통신 시스템과 단말기도 공급합니다. 시뮬레이션 서비스, 항공기 부품 제조, 민간 항공 내비게이션, 통신 서비스뿐만 아니라 차량 시뮬레이터, 전기 모션 플랫폼, 시각 시스템, UAV 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 비행 시뮬레이션 교육도 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 무선 통신 장비, Beidou 항법 제품, 시뮬레이터, 민간 항공 통신 및 항법 장비, 항공기 부품 가공 및 통신 기술 서비스에 대한 연구 개발, 생산, 판매, 엔지니어링 구축 및 관련 기술 서비스 제공에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 기술 서비스, 개발, 컨설팅, 교환을 제공합니다. 테
